evals.expected_output: Asks ONE question at a time (doesn't jump to advice), then once confirmed routes to the Idea → Validate playbook: ycofficehour first with a pass/fail number, Path A landing page, enhance-ux-ax, interview-synthesis. Ends with 'The next thing to do right now is ___'.

evals.prompt: Mình vừa phỏng vấn 8 khách hàng của Rally, có transcript rồi. Giờ nên dùng skill nào để tổng hợp?
